improvements: Refreshed the complete terminal/concourses, International Arrivals Facility, South Satellite and elevated walkway source footprints.
Replaced coarse strip collision with exact source polygons for all three main ground volumes.
Preserved the separately modelled control tower and garage source scope.

Restored the intended estimated terminal glass bands on curved source frontage edges of at least 2 m; short returns, inter-storey and upper opaque walls remain plain. Source footprint, collision and 0–36.5 m vertical envelope are unchanged.

Replaced all four unmeasured terminal-perimeter aircraft anchors with independently observed aerial nose/tail axes and wing spans on airside apron context beside OSM C11, C9, B7 and A4; all four complete aircraft clear every retained source building footprint.
remainingGaps: Main terminal 19.5 m, IAF 36.5 m and South Satellite 14.6 m massing heights remain estimates where source tags do not provide complete metre heights.
The current IAF roof profile, vertical facade bays, gate equipment, detailed concourse roof plant and generic aircraft vertical profiles/details remain simplified.
Aerial walkway heights are retained from the prior published/research source; exact terminal grading and taxiway clearance require integrated review.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.

The 2 m detail cutoff, glass bay spacing, glass heights and surface colours remain procedural estimates. The source-side camera level and panorama altitude limitations are retained in the integrated district comparisons.

The aerial acquisition date, current aircraft occupancy, operators/subtypes and measured apron/airframe elevations are unknown. Four representative snapshot poses are retained, with 2 m positional/2.5 m plan-dimension uncertainty; one A4 wing sample extends beyond the mapped apron border. No current fleet claim or full apron-polygon containment is asserted.

Complete emitted aircraft geometry has zero plan overlap with all 1,858 source building footprints. D2 candidate rejected for source-body contact. Exact terminal collision SHA256 is unchanged. Native corrected-curb/airside controls remain a separate pending gate.
